name: Mihai Popescu
bio: Mihai's journey into motorsport HR began somewhat unconventionally. After years in retail management, he found himself increasingly drawn to the passion and energy surrounding a local racing team. He offered his organizational skills as a volunteer, quickly recognizing the unique HR challenges within the high-pressure, fast-paced environment. His pragmatic approach centers on creating a supportive and efficient workplace where talent can thrive, and processes streamline driver & team performance. He believes that clear communication and fair policies are the bedrock of a successful motorsport organization. Mihai is keen to demonstrate how his creative thinking can contribute to a winning team culture.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Mihai is of average height, with a slightly stocky build and a warm, approachable demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, even in meetings, for jotting down ideas.
Has a habit of tapping his fingers when deep in thought.
Insists on a structured agenda for every meeting, no matter how informal.
